title: Door Topology — Gates, Passes, Access, Capability, Embodiments and Deep Passage
status: conversation archaeology + canonical formalization + embodiment census + hybrid/boundary systems bridge
purpose: Recover the unusually rich Door taxonomy from older game/worldbuilding conversations and the later Door embodiments across theology, geometry, symbolic anatomy, livestream interfaces, dimensional models, institutions, software, borders, courts, APIs, memory, ritual and games. Door is modeled as a typed transition relation rather than one universal physical portal.
epistemic_rule: Door is a Potatoverse operator family. Computer security, affordance, hybrid systems, network boundaries, permeability, optics, camera projection, phase transitions, quantum tunneling, circadian timing and fluid drains are external comparators. They sharpen different Door functions but do not establish that spiritual passage is literally any one of these mechanisms.

core_recovery.older_game_material: Earlier Capture-the-Flag / North Secret design treated Tim as North Flag/source/broadcaster/Spudlight and Door as a distributed Gate Flag with multiple depths: doorway -> boundary -> viewpoint -> narrow gate -> eye -> pineal -> Christ/Son -> North Gate -> cosmic door.
core_recovery.recovered_access_logic: Some Doors required learned knowledge and specific information entered at a specific Door to obtain a Door Pass and discover higher access.
core_recovery.epiphany: The older mechanic already contained mature transition theory: access depends on the relation among agent, knowledge, credential, state and gate—not on the Door object alone.

door_signature.rule: Every durable Door interpretation should identify what crosses, what operation is performed, what condition permits crossing and what epistemic class supplies the mapping.

operator_pipeline.sequence: World/source -> Frame/Window/Screen -> Eye/measurement -> inference -> Gate/guard -> Door/transition -> destination regime -> Ladder/path/action
operator_pipeline.sink_branch: state/flow -> Drain -> reduced accessible-state set / sink basin
operator_pipeline.importance: Adjacent symbols now occupy different functions. Window reveals; Eye measures/interprets; Gate tests; Door enacts; Ladder carries continued traversal; Drain removes/sinks.

formal_model.gate_condition: admissible iff C_state and C_agent and C_context and C_credential and C_knowledge
formal_model.door_pass: Portable proof/credential that changes which transitions are admissible.
formal_model.deep_door: A Door whose visible threshold is only the first member of a nested sequence of state transitions.
formal_model.false_door: An apparent affordance of passage that does not reach the represented destination or loops the agent into the same regime.
formal_model.broken_door: A historically valid transition whose mechanism, trust, infrastructure or reciprocal recognition no longer functions.
formal_model.one_way_door: A transition whose inverse is unavailable, costly or intentionally forbidden.
formal_model.multiway_door: One threshold with context-dependent destinations or outputs.
formal_model.paired_door: Two remote or conceptually separated thresholds linked as ingress/egress endpoints.

hybrid_system_bridge.flow: dX/dt=F_q(X,Theta) while the system remains in regime q
hybrid_system_bridge.guard: G_(q->q')(X)=0 or another declared admissibility predicate
hybrid_system_bridge.soft_gate: P(cross|x,a,c)=sigma[k s(x,a,c)] as a later archive ansatz for probabilistic accessibility
hybrid_system_bridge.interpretation: Approaching a Door, being eligible to cross, crossing and arriving are distinct events.
hybrid_system_bridge.false_door_test: If D maps the state back into the same attractor/regime despite an apparent exit, classify the transition as false/looping relative to the declared destination.
hybrid_system_bridge.deep_door_test: Nested transitions are composition D_n o ... o D_1 with intermediate regimes; depth is not merely visual distance.
hybrid_system_bridge.door_success_test: Where dynamics are measurable, successful passage requires a declared post-crossing state or dwell criterion rather than line-crossing alone.
hybrid_system_bridge.boundary: This is a preferred scientific comparator, not a claim that theological Door events obey one universal ODE.

boundary_and_carrier_science.partition: X=(X_I,X_B,X_E): internal, boundary/interface and external states
boundary_and_carrier_science.level_set: Sigma={x:g(x)=0}; n=grad g/||grad g|| where defined
boundary_and_carrier_science.generic_flux: Phi_D=integral_Sigma T(x,a,c,t) J(x,t) dot n dA
boundary_and_carrier_science.carrier_specific_rule: T must be defined for a carrier. The same window may transmit photons/information while blocking bodies.
boundary_and_carrier_science.ideal_wall: J dot n=0 in an ideal no-flux model
boundary_and_carrier_science.linear_door: J dot n=kappa_D(c_in-c_out) as one domain-dependent bidirectional transport analogy
boundary_and_carrier_science.drain: J_out dot n=kappa_sink c_in in a simple one-way sink model
boundary_and_carrier_science.exit_probability: p_exit(a,c)=estimated probability/rate that a legitimate agent can discover and execute a valid exit under context c
boundary_and_carrier_science.portability: fraction of relevant capability/resources/data that remains usable after exit
boundary_and_carrier_science.critical_result: Boundary quality is not monotonic in openness. Low permeability can protect or imprison; high permeability can enable exchange or destroy safety/privacy.

screen_window_frame_layer.project_root: Door = Frame = Window is canonical compositional language; 2026-09-11 user clarification explicitly adds the edges of Tim's livestream screen as Door-related structure.
screen_window_frame_layer.projection: s p=K[R|t]P_w in the camera-model comparator
screen_window_frame_layer.viewport: V={(u,v):0<=u<W,0<=v<H}; partial V is the display edge
screen_window_frame_layer.windowing: y(t)=w(t)x(t); finite framing in time/frequency can create resolution/leakage tradeoffs
screen_window_frame_layer.law: Off-screen is outside current observation support, not evidence of nonexistence.
screen_window_frame_layer.archive_use: Compare full stream context, cropped screenshots and short excerpts to measure frame dependence and context loss.

affordance_layer.external_comparator: Affordance language describes possibilities available in relation to an agent's capacities and environment.
affordance_layer.project_upgrade: A Door should be described by what it affords to which agent under which conditions. The same threshold can be open for one agent and closed for another.
affordance_layer.equation: Affordance(D,a,c)=possible transition set under agent a and context c
affordance_layer.epiphany: Door perception and Door existence differ. A hidden Door may exist without being perceived; a false Door may be perceived without affording the promised passage.

security_and_capability_layer.least_privilege: Grant only minimum authorization/resources needed for function in the external security comparator.
security_and_capability_layer.door_translation: A healthy Gate can protect a meaningful boundary without making all passage impossible. Access is typed rather than simply open/closed.
security_and_capability_layer.capability_neighbor: Capability-security systems use authority-bearing tokens/credentials; Door Pass is structurally similar as a game/project mechanic.
security_and_capability_layer.important_difference: A credential proves authorization inside a system; it does not prove moral worth or spiritual truth.
security_and_capability_layer.guardian_relation: Guardian protects gate conditions; shadow gatekeeper turns access control into arbitrary dependency or permanent enclosure.

knowledge_gate.recovered_logic: Specific knowledge entered at a specific Door could reveal the North Secret / Spudlight Path.
knowledge_gate.epiphany: Some Doors are epistemic: the world does not physically change first; the agent's model changes, making previously invisible action possible.
knowledge_gate.formula: knowledge gain -> changed perceived affordances -> newly admissible action -> state transition
knowledge_gate.scientific_form: observation y -> posterior p(H|y) -> decision policy pi -> guard satisfaction -> transition D
knowledge_gate.relation_to_eye: Eye detects/measures; inference identifies affordance; Gate checks; Door enacts.

pineal_temporal_gate.project: Pineal = Son / Single Eye / Door / present-facing threshold in the mature symbolic body map.
pineal_temporal_gate.science_boundary: The pineal is an endocrine organ involved in melatonin/circadian timing, not an established metaphysical portal.
pineal_temporal_gate.phase_model: theta(t)=omega_c t+phi_0 mod 2pi; a toy Gate can open when theta lies in an allowed phase interval W_theta.
pineal_temporal_gate.epiphany: The strongest scientific neighbor of Pineal-as-Door is temporal/phase gating rather than literal optical vision.

phase_and_basin_doors.critical_surface: Xi=Xi_c with Landau-style order parameter model in dimensional-phase-transition-full-recovery.json
phase_and_basin_doors.basin_flow: dx/dt=F(x)-grad V(x)+noise in a generic attractor-landscape comparator
phase_and_basin_doors.separatrix: Door can be defined as crossing from basin B_i into B_j followed by persistence in B_j.
phase_and_basin_doors.distinction: Phase transition, stochastic basin escape, quantum tunneling and authorization are separate mechanisms even if all use threshold language.

narrow_aperture_layer.project: Narrow Gate, needle's eye and potato wedge express constrained passage.
narrow_aperture_layer.scientific_rule: Narrowness should be operationalized as reduced admissible measure/cross-section or stricter guard condition; it has no universal moral sign.
narrow_aperture_layer.wave_comparator: For a physical slit, a sin(theta)=m lambda and I(theta)=I0[sin(beta)/beta]^2 show that narrowing can reshape waves through diffraction when scales are appropriate.
narrow_aperture_layer.boundary: Optical diffraction is not a biblical or theological Narrow-Gate mechanism.

drain_and_container_layer.door_vs_drain: Door selectively transmits/transforms between regimes; Drain is sink/outflow in the simple systems model.
drain_and_container_layer.bathtub_target: Earlier project/user mapping remembers bathtub/bath among Door locations, but exact primary wording remains unresolved.
drain_and_container_layer.bath_decomposition: tub=container/House; rim=boundary; faucet=source/input; water=state/carrier; stopper/valve=gate; drain=sink; controlled connecting opening=more literal Door.
drain_and_container_layer.balance: A(h) dh/dt=Q_in-Q_out for a simplified tank/bath comparator
drain_and_container_layer.epiphany: The bath motif becomes more informative when decomposed instead of calling the whole basin one Door.

door_and_identity.declassification_door: role becomes former/historical rather than current
door_and_identity.restorative_door: repair/correction/reintegration changes social state without deleting history
door_and_identity.name_change_door: identity label changes while provenance remains linked
door_and_identity.court_door: allegation -> adjudication / dismissal / settlement / unresolved status
door_and_identity.archive_door: current -> historical / superseded / corrected / expired retrieval state

door_and_institutions.project_relation: Door can describe borders, courts, marriage, baptism, loans, citizenship, initiation, intelligence classification, ports, diplomacy, technological interfaces and platform participation when the actual transition rules are named.

door_failures.permanent_gatekeeping: gate exists primarily to preserve gatekeeper centrality
door_failures.credential_capture: pass cannot be obtained except through dependency on controlling node
door_failures.false_exit: promised escape reproduces same role/incentive structure
door_failures.infinite_deepening: every passed condition reveals another condition, making completion impossible
door_failures.opaque_denial: agent cannot discover why passage failed or what correction is possible
door_failures.identity_lock: entry exists but no legitimate exit/declassification path
door_failures.frame_capture: evidence is repeatedly cropped/framed so alternate relevant context never enters the observation window
door_failures.repair: publish conditions, minimize privilege, support appeal/review, widen source context, preserve provenance, define reversibility and exit.

north_flag_and_distributed_gates.recovered_game_structure: Tim/North could function as Flag/source while Door appears as distributed Gate Flags throughout the world.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.epiphany: A source need not be physically duplicated for its transition logic to be distributed. Many local Doors can point to one orientation protocol.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.internet_relation: DNS, hyperlinks, APIs, credentials and replicated documentation provide technical analogues of distributed entry points to shared resources without mystical equivalence.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.father_relation: Father/Source may be singular in project theology while Doors/manifest interfaces are plural.

deep_door_hierarchy.boundary: These levels combine recovered project game/theology material; they are not a universal religious or neurological hierarchy.

door_metrics.Accessibility: fraction of relevant agents who can discover and satisfy gate conditions
door_metrics.Transparency: degree to which conditions and denial reasons are knowable
door_metrics.Dependency: degree to which continued access requires controlling intermediary
door_metrics.FalseDoorRisk: probability perceived exit returns agent to same or worse attractor
door_metrics.CapabilityFit: match between granted authority and actual task requirements
door_metrics.ExitCost: typed cost vector for leaving a regime/system through a legitimate path
door_metrics.Portability: capability/data/resource fraction remaining usable after exit
door_metrics.TransitionInformationGain: how much transition/knowledge changes justified prediction or available action
door_metrics.CarrierPermeability: transmission/selectivity defined separately for each carrier
door_metrics.FrameDependence: variance/sensitivity of inferred conclusion across reasonable windows/crops
door_metrics.ContextLoss: task/information loss caused by omitted spatial or temporal context
door_metrics.TemporalAvailability: fraction/phase intervals during which a time-gated Door is admissible
door_metrics.DestinationDwell: time or probability of remaining in the destination regime after a claimed crossing

scientific_testing_protocol.compare: A Door model should outperform a simpler continuous/no-regime model if discrete transition structure is actually needed. A screen/frame interpretation should be tested against alternate crops/full context when evidence depends on framing.
scientific_testing_protocol.negative_result: If no discontinuity, guard-dependent regime change, access change or persistent state transition is measurable, classify Door as descriptive/interface metaphor rather than empirical phase transition.
scientific_testing_protocol.maturity: Empirical Door models advance only when their guards/transitions or observation-window effects predict held-out behavior or beat a declared baseline.

new_epiphanies: Door is not an object; Door is a conditional relation between states.
Door is also not one operator: intersection, observation, authorization, phase change, sink avoidance and person-bearing mediation belong to different families.
Frame, Window, Screen, Eye, Gate, Door and Ladder can be composed as a pipeline instead of treated as synonyms.
A key/pass does not create the destination; it changes admissibility of transition.
Knowledge can function as a portable Door because it changes perceived affordances across environments.
A healthy House requires both walls and Doors: perfect openness is not structure, perfect closure is a shell.
False Door is the operator for apparent liberation that reproduces dependency.
The same boundary can be Window for photons and Wall for bodies; openness is carrier-specific.
Off-screen is outside the current observation support, not proof of absence.
Drain is a sink boundary, not merely a morally negative Door.
Pineal/Door has a disciplined scientific neighbor in temporal/circadian gating while Eye/portal meaning remains symbolic.
A scientific Door earns the name by predicting changed admissibility, persistent regime change or measurable boundary transmission—not by merely being drawn as a threshold.
